rules.winValue: Be the first to take your {{count}} Prime Cards
rules.goal2: If both players take their last Prime at the same time: draw.
rules.goal3: A player who must draw from an empty deck loses.
rules.setup1: Deck: {{min}} to {{max}} cards, max {{copies}} copies per card.
rules.setup2: Prime Zone: the first {{count}} cards of the shuffled deck, face down.
rules.setup3: Starting hand: {{count}} cards. Mulligan: once, you may shuffle your hand into the deck and draw {{count}} new cards.
rules.setup4: The first player is chosen at random.
rules.board2: 3 Support Zones for Persistents and Charges.
rules.monsters: Monsters: ATK / HP, archetype, cost from 0 to 3 Energy, passive or triggered effects. A monster can attack as soon as it is summoned, unless its card says otherwise.
rules.ephemeral: Single use, then discarded. Some require choosing a target monster.
rules.charge: Gains a counter at the start of each of your turns; its effect triggers once full.
rules.equipment: Attached to one of your monsters; some effects only work on a specific monster.
rules.energy1: Generate: recycle cards from your hand during the Main Phase. 1 card = 1 Energy.
rules.energy2: Without enough energy, you pay the rest by discarding cards when summoning.
rules.energy3: Reset: energy drops back to 0 at the end of the turn.
rules.atk1: One attack per turn (unless an effect says otherwise). Strikes back when attacked.
rules.atk2: If destroyed → the opponent gains 1 Prime.
rules.guard1: Can neither attack nor strike back.
rules.guard2: If destroyed → no Prime, except against a Piercing attacker.
rules.direct: Direct attack (not on turn 1) if the opponent has no monster: you gain 1 Prime and the opponent draws 1 card.
rules.primes1: Destruction: when one of your monsters is destroyed in combat or by an opposing effect, you draw 1 card.
rules.primes2: Recovery: a Prime you gain goes to your hand.
rules.primes3: Double K.O: two ATK monsters destroy each other → each player draws 1 card and takes 1 Prime.
rules.phaseStartDesc: Start-of-turn effects, then draw 1 card (turn 1 included).
rules.phaseMainDesc: Recycle for Energy, summon, play Supports, change your monsters' position.
rules.phaseBattleDesc: Attack the opposing monsters, or attack directly if the opposing board is empty.
rules.timer: 90 s per phase: when time runs out, the next phase starts automatically.
rules.phaseControlDesc: End-of-turn effects, then you rearrange your board: Supports, Relief, Origins Drakon and evolution are allowed; normal summons, recycling, Transform and mode changes are not. Energy → 0, {{limit}} cards max in hand (discard the excess).
rules.guard3: At most {{turns}} opposing turns in Guard in a row, then the monster returns to Attack with a +{{atk}} ATK counter-offensive per turn held. It cannot go back to Guard the turn it leaves.
rules.primes4: A destruction caused by an effect gives no Prime.
rules.primes5: A monster in Guard killed by another monster's Reflect: no Prime.
rules.supportLimits: Only one Field at a time (the new one replaces the old); no two Persistents with the same name; a Support that needs a card (a specific monster) fades away when it is gone.

special.evolution: Evolution (Drakon): a higher-stage card goes on top of its previous stage; you only pay the cost difference. A base played this turn can only evolve next turn.
special.transform: Transform: discard a card from your hand to transform it, once per turn.
special.releve: Relief: sacrifice the stated number of Pipou allies instead of paying the cost; the new monster takes the place of one of them.
special.zeta: Implanted Zeta: a parasite monster placed on the opposing board (one at a time). When its countdown hits 0 it is destroyed and its owner takes a Prime; if the host destroys it first (disinfection), nobody does.
special.origins: Origins Drakon: can only be summoned with an Adult or Ancestral of each of the 4 elements in the graveyard.

pipou.name: Pipou
pipou.gameplay: An army that wins by sticking together. Chevalier Touille gives a free summon while a Pipou is in play, and Tactique Gang Gang gives all your monsters +300 ATK. Général Chatouille boosts his allies' ATK when he attacks. Mastodonte Grossebouille and Capitaine Gribouille guard the line with Taunt, and Ouille au rapport brings back up to 3 fallen Pipou.
pipou.how_to_play:
Fill the board fast with cheap Pipou such as Éclaireur Nouille and Sentinelle Gargouille.
Keep a Pipou in play so Chevalier Touille gives you free summons.
Play Tactique Gang Gang when you have several monsters: the bonus covers the whole line.
Hide fragile monsters behind the Taunt of Capitaine Gribouille and Mastodonte Grossebouille.
Save Général Chatouille and Alerte générale for one big attack turn.

pixelman.name: Pixelman
pixelman.gameplay: Everything revolves around the Noyaux (Cores). Noyau Alpha soaks up hits with Taunt and damage reduction, Noyau Beta deals 300 damage to every enemy at the start of each turn, and Noyau Omega gives your Pixelman +300 ATK and +300 HP. Equip them with modules like Canon à Particules or Module de Réparation, and use Force Plasma to remove a threat: one Noyau in play is enough.
pixelman.how_to_play:
Play Noyau Alpha first: its Taunt protects the rest of your team.
Equip your Noyaux: Canon à Particules to hit hard, Module de Réparation to last, Firewall de Surcharge when Noyau Alpha or Noyau Beta is in play.
Keep Force Plasma for the enemy monster that bothers you most: 1500 damage, with a Noyau in play.
Verrou de Position and Protocole de Gel shut down an enemy monster.
If your Drone Éclaireur falls, it fetches a Pixelman support from your deck.

dragon.name: Drakon
dragon.gameplay: Your Drakons grow up: Baby, Young, Adult, then Ancestral, each stage stronger than the last. Eggs (Genèse, Dualité) hatch into a Baby after 2 turns, and Incubation Rapide speeds up hatching or lets you evolve right away. The deck mixes Ackos (water), which heals and recovers cards, with Feros (fire), which hits hard. Souffle Primordial and Mont Drakon keep the pressure on.
dragon.how_to_play:
Start with an Egg: Œuf de la Genèse gives the Baby of your choice after 2 turns.
Evolve your Drakons one stage at a time, within the same element: Baby, Young, Adult, then Ancestral.
Incubation Rapide speeds up hatching by 2 turns or allows an evolution this turn.
Mont Drakon returns a Drakon monster at the start of each turn: play it early.
Souffle Primordial gives your Drakons +300 ATK, +600 with an Adult: perfect to finish.

first-turn.goal: Welcome! The goal: take your 6 Primes before the opponent. You win a Prime by destroying a monster or attacking directly.
first-turn.hand: This is your hand. Each turn starts with a draw. Playing a card costs Energy, which you get by recycling cards from your hand.
first-turn.recycle: Recycle the highlighted card with the Recycle button: 1 recycled card = 1 Energy.
first-turn.summonEnergy: Summon Lieutenant Bidouille (cost 1) on the highlighted zone. Your Energy pays its cost.
first-turn.summonPay: No Energy left? Pay by discarding cards. Summon Guerrier Bafouille (cost 1) and discard the highlighted card.
first-turn.board: Both your monsters are in play. On turn 1 nobody attacks: let's move through the phases.
first-turn.opponentRecycle: The opponent recycles a card to gain Energy.
first-turn.opponentSummon: Then they summon a monster with Taunt.
first-turn.nextTurn: This is your second turn. You drew a card at the start: it is automatic, every turn.
first-turn.done: Well done! You can draw, recycle, summon and move through phases. Next lesson: combat.

combat.intro: Time to fight. A monster in Attack mode strikes during the battle phase, once per turn. You have 3 Primes left to take.
combat.attackRiposte: Attack Lieutenant Fripouille with Chevalier Touille by selecting them on screen.
combat.riposte: Damage equals ATK: Fripouille loses 500 HP. But it strikes back: Chevalier loses 100 HP in turn.
combat.attackKill: Finish it with Lieutenant Bidouille. It has 200 HP left: Bidouille's ATK is enough.
combat.prime: A monster in Attack mode is destroyed: you take 1 Prime (it joins your hand) and the opponent draws a card.
combat.opponentToBattle: The opponent moves to their battle phase.
combat.doubleKo: Their Archer attacks your Scout. Both monsters are nearly down…
combat.doubleKoInfo: Double K.O.: both monsters destroy each other. Each player draws a card and takes 1 Prime.
combat.emptyBoard: Their board is empty: you can strike directly (not on turn 1). Go to the battle phase.
combat.direct: Direct attack with Chevalier Touille: you take 1 Prime. It is your last one: you win the game!

guard.intro: A monster in Guard can neither attack nor strike back, but it protects your Prime: destroyed in Guard, it gives no Prime. Put your three monsters in Guard.
guard.noPrime: Their Archer attacks Bidouille, which cannot strike back: it is destroyed.
guard.noPrimeInfo: Bidouille is destroyed, but the opponent takes no Prime: that is the point of Guard.
guard.piercing: But the Marauder has Piercing: it attacks Chevalier, also in Guard.
guard.piercingInfo: A Piercing attacker ignores Guard's protection: Chevalier is destroyed and the opponent takes its Prime.
guard.opponentToBattle: The opponent moves to their battle phase.
guard.turnHeld: Prêtre Fouille held its first opposing turn. You can stay in Guard for 2 opposing turns at most. Let's pass this turn.
guard.counter: Two turns held: Prêtre leaves Guard with a counter-offensive of +100 ATK per turn held, for this turn. It cannot go straight back to Guard.
guard.counterAttack: Go to battle and strike the Archer with Prêtre Fouille.
guard.done: You know Guard: it holds back Primes, but not for more than two turns, and not against Piercing.

supports.intro: Supports cost no Energy. Four families: Ephemeral, Equipment, Persistent (Field) and Charge.
supports.ephemeral: Play the Ephemeral Frappe Préventive on the opposing Archer: an Ephemeral acts once, then goes to the graveyard.
supports.ephemeralDone: The Archer loses 300 HP (600 if you had a Fire Drakon).
supports.equipment: An Equipment attaches to one of your monsters. Equip Noyau Beta with the Calculation Processor.
supports.slot: Each monster has slots: one Offensive, one Defensive, two Accessories. The Cannon is also Offensive: choose to replace the Processor.
supports.terrain: A Persistent stays in play and acts continuously. A Field is a Persistent: only one at a time. Play Tactique Gang Gang.
supports.terrainDone: Your Pipou monsters gain +300 ATK while the Tactic is there.
supports.charge: A Charge gains a counter at the start of each of your turns and acts once full. Play Alerte générale: it requires Général Chatouille on your board.
supports.chargeDone: In 3 turns, your monsters will attack once more. If the General leaves the board, the Charge fades away.

control.intro: After combat comes the control phase: you can still rearrange your board before passing the turn.
control.controlPhase: Chevalier lost HP but is still here. In this phase you can play Supports, summon by Relief or evolve a Drakon.
control.support: Heal Chevalier Touille with the Support Soin d'urgence.
control.noSummon: Try to summon Lieutenant Bidouille: normal summons are forbidden in the control phase. So are recycling, Transform and mode changes.
control.handLimit: You cannot end your turn with more than 7 cards in hand. Discard the excess.
control.done: Now you can end your turn: the control phase holds no more secrets.

pipou.intro: Pipou play as a group: cheap monsters, synergies and free summons.
pipou.clairon: Play the Support Clairon de l'Union: it gives you 2 Energy at once.
pipou.gribouille: Summon Capitaine Gribouille (cost 2): Energy pays its cost.
pipou.free: Chevalier Touille, still in hand, reacts: as soon as a Pipou ally arrives, it can be summoned for free.
pipou.bidouille: Summon Lieutenant Bidouille by discarding the highlighted card.
pipou.taunt: The Captain has Taunt: enemies must attack it first.
pipou.releve: Relief replaces the cost: summon Général Chatouille by sacrificing Bidouille and Chevalier. It takes Bidouille's place.
pipou.releveDone: The General (ATK 800) becomes 1100 with the Tactic. The two sacrificed monsters are in the graveyard.
pipou.opponentToBattle: The opponent moves to their battle phase.
pipou.opponentTaunt: Their Archer wants to strike, but has no choice: Taunt forces it to target the Captain.
pipou.done: Pipou win through numbers and synergies. Next family: Drakon.

drakon.intro: Drakon grow up: Egg, Baby, Young, Adult, Ancestral. Only Eggs and Babies are played directly; the others arrive by evolution.
drakon.recycle: Recycle the highlighted card for 1 Energy.
drakon.eggInfo: The Egg hatches after 2 turns: you then pick a Baby from your deck or graveyard. But you can speed it up.
drakon.incubation: Play Incubation Rapide on your Egg: it advances hatching by 2 turns.
drakon.stages: A Young or an Adult is never played from hand. Try to summon Adulte Feros anyway…
drakon.noShortcut: Refused: a Young or an Adult only arrives by evolution, stage by stage.
drakon.evolve: Evolve Bébé Tempestu: play Jeune Tempestu on it and discard the highlighted card. You only pay the cost difference.
drakon.evolveDone: Tempestu can evolve as soon as it arrives; other Drakon wait a turn before they can evolve.
drakon.transform: A Young or Adult stuck in hand is not lost: Transform discards Adulte Feros to fetch a Baby of its lineage (once per turn).
drakon.done: Egg, hatching, evolution, Transform: you know the Drakon cycle.

pixelman.intro: Pixelman rely on powerful Cores, equipment and targeted Supports.
pixelman.equipment: Equip Noyau Delta with the Particle Cannon.
pixelman.plasma: Force Plasma needs a Core on your board. Play it on the opposing Archer.
pixelman.noPrime: The Archer is destroyed, but your Prime does not move: a destruction caused by an effect never gives a Prime.
pixelman.zetaCountdown: The Noyau Zeta on the other side is yours: an implanted parasite whose countdown drops at the start of each of your turns. End your turn.
pixelman.zetaExplodes: The countdown reached 0: the Zeta explodes, deals 500 damage to the host's monsters and you take a Prime.
pixelman.implant: Implant a new Zeta on the opposing board (cost 2, discard the highlighted cards). Pick the free opposing zone.
pixelman.implantInfo: A Zeta removes 300 ATK from the host's monsters. But the host can attack it: end your turn to see.
pixelman.opponentToBattle: The opponent moves to their battle phase.
pixelman.disinfect: The host attacks its own Zeta: that is disinfection. No riposte.
pixelman.done: Zeta destroyed by the host before the end: no Prime for you. The countdown must reach 0.

statuses.intro: This lesson shows what opponents can inflict on you: restraints, then the immunities that block them.
statuses.freeze: The opponent plays a Freeze on your Chevalier: it cannot attack for 3 of your turns.
statuses.lock: Then a Verrou de Position on your Guardian: it is stuck in Guard.
statuses.forced: Finally a Rootkit on your Chevalier: forced attack, it can no longer go into Guard.
statuses.restraints: Here are your restraints: Freeze (no attack), Guard lock (stuck in Guard until attacked) and Forced attack. Let's try them.
statuses.lockedMode: Try to put Gardien Ratouile in Attack mode: it is locked.
statuses.forcedMode: Try to put Chevalier Touille in Guard mode: it is under forced attack.
statuses.summonTurn: Some cards have their own limits. Summon Commandant Quenouille by discarding the highlighted cards.
statuses.combatStatuses: Combat statuses: Taunt, Bypass (ignores Taunt), Piercing, Damage reduction, Reflect, Double attack, Temporary ATK. Now immunities.
statuses.immune: Play your Protocole de Gel on Adulte Teros. It is protected by Anti-Support.
statuses.immuneInfo: Refused: Anti-Support makes Support penalties (freeze, lock, stat drops) have no effect.
statuses.notImmune: Now play your Protocole de Gel on the Archer, which has no immunity.
statuses.immunities: Immunities: Combat immunity (no combat damage), Anti-Support and Anti-monster (penalties from enemy Supports or monsters have no effect), Plating (a Support cannot destroy it), Unfazed (ignores Taunt, Reflect and the Zeta virus), Unkillable (stays at 1 HP in combat). Immune to enemy effects combines Plating, Anti-Support, Anti-monster and Unfazed.
statuses.frozenAttack: Go to battle: the frozen Chevalier cannot attack. Try it.
statuses.summonedAttack: Try Commandant Quenouille too, summoned this turn: it cannot attack the turn it is summoned.
statuses.done: Restraints, statuses, immunities: you can read a board. Every monster has its effect sheet during a game.
